problem.uploadInterrupted: The upload was interrupted. Try again.
problem.archiveList: Pick a list of this workspace.
problem.archiveFile: File the issue under one of the archived lists.

problem.notYourLanguage.message: {language} isn't one of your languages. Add it in Settings › General first.
problem.notYourLanguage.note: language: a language's name, like Spanish

problem.pagesWrittenIn.message: The pages are written in {language}: change that text on each page's tab.
problem.pagesWrittenIn.note: language: a language's name, like English

problem.noPageString: The pages have no text to translate there any more. Reload the page.

problem.privacyTranslation.message: Use a full address like https://acme.io/es/privacidad.
problem.privacyTranslation.note: the privacy policy's address in another language; the example stays as is

problem.labelsShipped.message: ReputeCast ships the {language} labels, so they're ready and can't be changed here.
problem.labelsShipped.note: language: a language's name, like Vietnamese

problem.notLabel: That isn't one of the built-in labels. Reload the page.

problem.labelNoPlaceholders.message: “{name}” isn't in the English label, which has no placeholders. Write the text without it.
problem.labelNoPlaceholders.note: name: a placeholder or tag that was written, like {email} or <b>

problem.labelPlaceholder.message: “{name}” isn't in the English label. Use only {allowed}.
problem.labelPlaceholder.note: allowed: the placeholders the label has, like publisher, email

problem.labelUnclosed.message: Check the braces '{ }' and tags '< >' of this text: one isn't closed.
problem.labelUnclosed.note: the braces and angle brackets are shown as they are

problem.noLabelField: The form has no field there that takes a label. Reload the page.
problem.fieldLabel80: Keep a field's label under 80 characters.
problem.nameButton: Name the button: visitors press it to sign up.

problem.consentUpToDate.message: The {language} consent text doesn't need a review: it's up to date with the form's.
problem.consentUpToDate.note: language: a language's name, like Spanish

problem.pickFixed: Pick the language the form always shows.

problem.pickMode.note: page, browser and fixed are the API's values

problem.domainName: Use a domain name like news.acme.io, without https:// or a path.
problem.domainOwn: That's this ReputeCast's own address. Use a domain of your newsletter, like news.acme.io.
problem.domainTaken: {domain} already serves another workspace's pages. Remove it there first.

problem.notContactField.message: {key} isn't a contact field. Add it under Audience › Fields first.
problem.notContactField.note: key: a field key, like plan

problem.offerList: Offer at least one list: signups need somewhere to go.
problem.redirectURL: Use a full address like https://acme.io/thanks.

problem.notDomainQuoted.message: {value} isn't a domain. Use a site's address, like docs.acme.io.
problem.notDomainQuoted.note: value: what was written, in quotes

problem.notDomain: That isn't a domain. Use a site's address, like docs.acme.io.
problem.publisherName: Name the publisher: it heads every public page.
problem.fontFamily: Name the font family, as in the font's CSS.
problem.fontURL: Link the font file itself: an https address ending in .woff2 or .woff.
problem.privacyURL: Use a full address like https://acme.io/privacy.
problem.pickForm: Pick a form of this workspace.
problem.listLine300: Keep each list's line under 300 characters.
problem.fewerOffer: Give the offer a heading and a button, or turn it off.
problem.previewEmail: Enter a subscriber's email address, or leave it empty.

problem.logoTooBig.message: The logo is {kb} KB; the limit is 256 KB. An SVG or a 200 px PNG is plenty.

problem.logoScripts: This SVG contains scripts or embedded content. Export it again as a plain SVG or a PNG.
problem.logoType: That file isn't an image the pages can show. Upload an SVG, PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP.
problem.smsNeedsPhone: Add the Phone field: SMS consent needs a number to text.
problem.turnstileSiteKey: Paste the site key from the Cloudflare dashboard (it starts with 0x).
problem.turnstileSecret: Paste the secret key too; it's stored encrypted and never shown again.
problem.turnstileUnreadable: The stored secret can't be read any more. Paste it again.
problem.confirmedAlready: This signup is confirmed already; there's no link to send.

palette.notColour.message: {value} isn't a colour. Use a hex value like {example}
palette.notColour.note: value: what was written, in quotes; the problem gets its full stop when it's shown

palette.tooDark.message: {colour} is too dark for the page background: the footer text needs 4.5:1 against it. Pick a lighter colour
palette.tooDark.note: colour: a hex value; 4.5:1 is a contrast ratio

palette.whiteText.message: White text on {accent} is {ratio}:1, under the 4.5:1 buttons need, so buttons use dark text.
palette.whiteText.note: a note under the branding's colours; accent: a hex value; ratio: like 3.2

palette.darkerLinks.message: Links use {colour}, a darker shade, so they keep 4.5:1 on white and on the background.

domain.unavailable.message: DNS checks aren't available on this server.
domain.unavailable.note: the custom domain's check, under the domain in Branding & domain

domain.wrongCname: {domain} is a CNAME for {cname}, not {target}. Point it at {target}.
domain.noAnswer: DNS didn't answer for {domain}. We'll check again in a few minutes.
domain.noCname: No CNAME from {domain} to {target} yet. DNS changes can take up to an hour to show.

domain.lastFailed.message: Last check failed: {detail} Checking again soon.
domain.lastFailed.note: detail: one of the domain.* findings

turnstile.siteUnknown: Cloudflare doesn't know this site key (error {code})

default.footnote.message: We'll send a confirmation link first. No spam, ever. You can change lists or pause emails from any message.
default.footnote.note: the Subscribe page's footnote until the publisher writes their own; shown in the page's language

default.fewerTitle.message: Too many emails? Get fewer instead.
default.fewerTitle.note: the unsubscribe page's offer, until the publisher writes their own

default.fewerText: Switch to one monthly best-of and nothing else. Most people who pick this stay subscribed.
default.fewerButton: Send me the monthly best-of only

default.formFootnote.message: We'll send a confirmation link first. No spam, ever.
default.formFootnote.note: a new form's footnote, in the form's own language

default.consent.message: I agree to receive emails from {publisher}. Unsubscribe any time with one click. See the privacy policy.
default.consent.note: a new form's consent text; "privacy policy" must be written as pagelabels' form.privacy, which links it

default.builtinHeading.note: the heading of the subscribe page of a workspace without forms

default.addressInvalid.message: This address doesn't seem to exist. Check it and try again.
default.addressInvalid.note: an English form's answer when the verification service finds no mailbox; other languages use the built-in label error.emailInvalid
